name: Calculator
highLevelGoals: The user aims to perform fundamental arithmetic operations (addition, subtraction, multiplication, division) accurately and efficiently using the smartphone calculator app.
The user desires a simple and intuitive user interface that allows for easy input of numbers and selection of operations, ensuring a smooth and frustration-free calculation experience.
The user wants to see the results of their calculations displayed clearly and immediately on the screen, enabling quick verification of answers.
lowLevelGoals: The user will input a numerical value into the calculator display.
The user will choose the addition operation to be applied to the input numbers.
The user will choose the subtraction operation to be applied to the input numbers.
The user will choose the multiplication operation to be applied to the input numbers.
The user will choose the division operation to be applied to the input numbers.
The user will trigger the calculation process to display the result.
The user will reset the calculator display to prepare for a new calculation.
The user will observe the input and operations as they are entered.
The user will see the final answer displayed on the screen without delay.
The user will visually confirm that the result is correct.
